Giám đốc Điều hành, Trưởng Bộ phận Định: Executive Director, Head of Valuation, Research & Consulting
Hội viên RICS (MRICS), chuyên về đầu tư: A Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (MRICS), specialising in real estate finance and investment. Oversees research, development consulting, hospitality and valuation. Previously managed construction investment projects at Feikema B.V. in the Netherlands.
Chủ tịch VMAA, tổ chức nghề nghiệp đầu t: Chair of VMAA, Vietnam’s first professional association dedicated to M&A. Appointed Head of the Prime Minister’s Economic Advisory Group in late 2019. Served as Vice Chair of the National Assembly’s Economic Committee during its 13th and 14th terms.
Hơn 25 năm tư vấn kinh tế, chiến lược do: Over 25 years of experience advising on economic policy and business strategy in the United States and Vietnam. Former senior adviser to the US Congressional Banking Committee. Co-authored a World Bank/IFC report on Vietnam’s private sector in 1996.
Phó Chủ tịch Thường trực Cơ quan điều hà: Standing Vice Chair of the Executive Authority
Trung tâm tài chính quốc tế Việt Nam tại: Vietnam International Financial Centre in Da Nang (VIFC-DN)
Tham gia điều hành VIFC-DN từ khi ra mắt: Has been involved in the management of VIFC-DN since its executive authority was launched. Former Deputy Director of the Da Nang Department of Finance and former Director of the Da Nang Institute for Socio-Economic Development.
Thạc sĩ Đại học Khoa học Kỹ thuật Toyoha: Holds a master’s degree from Toyohashi University of Technology, Japan. Chief Operating Officer of NewIT Inc. and Chief Executive Officer of VJPlus Inc., both based in Japan.
